openings.claim: Test pencilled pattern quantities, ticked after insertion, as omission prevention; rare sample use does not establish quantity confusion.
openings.discriminator: Incorrect picking supports selection failure; correct picking followed by omissions supports filling failure.
openings.probe: Alternate matched-mixture incumbent, shared-tray checklist and local-material batches; tally picked amounts, contents, checklist use, crossings and all elapsed time.
openings.uncertainty: Specifications, recording cost and table fit need verification; O4 mixture is unknown. Small-batch success cannot establish full-run success.

openings.claim: Local pre-counted batches with sample checks may reduce shared-picking interference; staging and stock-access costs may erase gains.
openings.discriminator: Fewer crossings without fewer picking errors or faster checked production defeats benefit; replenishment delays test throughput.
openings.probe: Compare matched shared versus local blocks; measure staging, picking/filling errors, replenishment, checking and peak area. Count compliant kits and distribution corrections in a timed 60-kit attempt.
openings.uncertainty: Opened-packet footprint and usable quantities are unverified; stock remained under the table during the stipulated shortage. Comparison overhead may prevent completion.

openings.claim: Exterior pattern names make assignment visible; verify contents against each name before closure.
openings.discriminator: Persistent identity exchanges despite correct consulted names defeat the marking explanation; assignment or contents mismatch is a rival.
openings.probe: Include naming and verification time; compare recipient assignment, exterior name, contents and exchanges at distribution.
openings.uncertainty: Assignments must be accessible; legibility and time costs remain untested. Naming does not establish completeness.

lineage.reason: Preserves quantity guidance and distinct exterior identity relation.
Preserves interference hypothesis and matched-mixture rival.
Preserves identity mechanism and mismatch rival.
Preserves replenishment and staging feasibility dependency.

decision: Probe these unresolved dependencies; all evidence is synthetic. Preserve specified quantities and dimensions, exactly two volunteers, at most 90 minutes including preparation and checks, the existing 180-by-75-centimetre table, existing envelopes and supplies, and no purchases/equipment. Success requires all 60 compliant kits before the workshop and at most one distribution correction; no proposed effect is demonstrated.
